# Harvin

> Harvin is an SDR management platform: one place for sales leaders to run a sales
> development team — territories and account ownership, prioritisation from live
> buying signals, execution across email, dialer, tasks and a unified inbox,
> meeting handoff to AEs with full context, and reporting from accounts worked
> through to pipeline generated, with AI coaching on which reps need help and why.
> Built for SDR leaders, SDR managers, CROs and sales leaders.

An SDR management platform differs from a sales engagement platform: engagement
tools help a rep execute sequences, calls and email; Harvin is the layer above
that — deciding who works which accounts, what each rep should do today, and
whether any of it created pipeline.

## Product
- [Platform overview](https://harvin.ai/platform): every module — team and
  territory management, accounts and leads, account intelligence, AI buying-signal
  detection, watchlists, look-a-like accounts, campaigns and channels, dialer,
  meetings and handoff, reporting and AI coaching, template builder. Includes an
  FAQ defining what an SDR management platform is.
- [Homepage](https://harvin.ai/): the problem SDR managers have — plenty of
  tools, no single place to run the team — and the platform narrative across the
  manager, rep and CRO views.
